text: Code reviews are an essential practice for any software development team. When developers write code, they can easily miss small mistakes. A code review involves another team member carefully checking the new code before it is added to the main project. This process is highly effective for catching bugs early, preventing small issues from becoming major problems later. Beyond finding errors, reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the system better. Ultimately, this collaboration raises the overall quality of the team. Everyone becomes more careful, more skilled, and more confident in the work they produce together.
